'''Bavva''' was a colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Color/Legends|gold]]-skinned [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Located on the [[Nothoiin Corridor]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], Bavva exported a foul-tasting [[Bavva ale|ale]] distilled from [[Moss/Legends|moss]] that [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]] loved and [[Human/Legends|Humans]] hated. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Taray]], a Nothoiin member of the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]], grew up in Bavva's lawless [[Kaniti]] province.

==Description==
The [[Moss/Legends|mossy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Bavva resided in the [[Bavva system/Legends|Bavva system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It sat on the [[Nothoiin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], near the planet [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] itself, and was the last stop for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] leaving the Anoat to enter<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> the adjacent [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]].<ref name="Tungra">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} shows that the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]] is the spinward neighbor of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region.</ref>

==History==
Bavva developed as a colony world for members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Color/Legends|gold]]-skinned [[Near-Human]]s who came from the neighboring planet Nothoiin. In the [[Millennium/Legends|thousand-year]] period before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], countless [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] plumbed the Greater Javin for an efficient route that would connect the central [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] with the Nothoiin [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. They sought to establish lasting [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] with Nothoiin's [[Alien/Legends|alien]] civilization, but their dreams were dashed by the region's vast [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]], a [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] nightmare.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] passed before the entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] succeeded where so many had failed. Figg's scout ships miraculously blazed new hyperspace routes through the tangles of the Twin Nebulae on either side of the Corellian Trade Spine to reach worlds previously accessible only by expensive, roundabout journeys. The new Nothoiin Corridor linked the Trade Spine with the planets Bavva and Nothoiin,<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> and even extended into the neighboring Tungra [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Tungra" /> Thanks to Figg's new hyperspace shortcuts, the Greater Javin exploded into an economic powerhouse.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Originally part of the Republic's [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]], Bavva was reorganized into the new Anoat sector<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> circa [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which is set during the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]] and [[New Republic era]]s ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]; see {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}), states that the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] was established in the last [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg's]] life. The text states that Figg [[Death/Legends|died]] nearly four [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to its setting, thus providing an approximate date of [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] for the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] establishment.</ref> Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War, Bavva experienced an influx of Nothoiin fleeing the [[Fire/Legends|wildfires]] that had plagued their home planet since before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Inhabitants==
The Nothoiin [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Taray]] grew up in the lawless marshlands of Bavva's [[Kaniti]] province. Taray went on to become a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], where he willingly broke local laws to enforce the spirit of those laws.<ref name="Rough and Tundra" />

Bavva exported a foul-tasting [[Ale/Legends|ale]] distilled from the planet's moss. Members of the [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] species loved Bavva ale and visited the planet on ale-sampling tours, but [[Human/Legends|Humans]] hated the [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Bavva" originated in the [[1989]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement, in reference to Bavva ale, which was sold on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] Cloud City.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> Drawing upon that original mention, the [[2004]] [[Wizards.com|online]] article "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," part of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', established Bavva as a planet located in Bespin's [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] region.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />
